scope: One local complement-path training invocation; three held-out identity paths; explicit one-variant pass budget compared separately from ordinary full shared compilation
protocol: Three alternating process windows, extended to five if any ratio exceeds 1.05; three warmups and nine samples per process; confirmation requires median >1.05 and at least four ratios >1.05
disposition: Shared profiled image equals ordinary compilation on measured fixture; isolated pass regressions are not final compiler gains. Collection is opt-in and its measured overhead is reported.
